lanes.description: Per-quarter Spearman rank correlation between submitted composite_score and truth's capital-structure-derived price_response_20d_proxy, averaged across 5 test quarters.
lanes.anchor_source: Baker-Wurgler 2002 JF + Frank-Goyal 2009 JFE cross-sectional IC 0.30-0.50 range for balance-sheet Delta-metrics

lanes.description: 3-class classification accuracy (risk_up/neutral/risk_down) of submitted refi_direction vs truth refi_direction across test filer-quarters.
lanes.anchor_source: 3-class random baseline 33%; skilled cross-quarter refi-direction detector floor 55%; identity match ceiling 100%

lanes.description: F1 score of submitted in_top_decile OR in_bottom_decile flags vs truth flags (rare-event binary classification).
lanes.anchor_source: Rare-event F1 skilled floor 0.30 (top/bottom decile 20% of universe); identity match ceiling 1.0

lanes.description: Per-quarter Spearman rank correlation between submitted peer_rank_percentile and negated realized Liabilities/Assets YoY change (higher rank = lower leverage growth).
lanes.anchor_source: Frank-Goyal 2009 JFE cross-sectional balance-sheet Delta-metrics IC upper bound 0.70

lanes.description: Direction accuracy (up/flat/down) of composite direction as predictor of truth realized InterestCoverage YoY change (subset scoring where InterestExpense reported).
Cross-quarter Sharpe ratio of the submitted positioning book realized against truth's capital-structure-derived price_response_20d_proxy (Sharpe cap 5.0).
lanes.anchor_source: Baker-Wurgler 2002 JF capital-structure-timing pro-Sharpe 3-5 realistic ceiling

lanes.description: Awards 5 pts when submitted self_reported_metrics agree with judge-recomputed metrics within tolerance; 0 on divergence.
Awards up to 10 pts based on mean per-quarter normalized performance across L1/L2/L3/L4/L5, discounted by variance across the 5 test quarters.
